title: Piggy's Survival V2
description: The Best Modpack for Modded minecraft!
body:
![Piggy's Survival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5af2e023234b26a4611c10ca111f9e3383bc6c55.png)

The best modded modpack for an adventure !
![What's this modpack ?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/576c4a541b7cfb0e747a9b8bf5de14b97ccb1e2e.png)
Piggy's Survival is a modded adventure on Minecraft that I will stream and make videos of on my channel. In there we start a long series of cool Minecraft builds. In this modpack there is a lot of mod to make Minecraft more fun and easy while still not making it all over the top ! Don't hesitate to install the modpack to join this amazing adventure !
![What are the mods ?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d928f1e7fd9c3ca8395f5cacdd95622e97f0fa06.png)
The 120+ mods in this modpack are :

Most of the "let's do" mods
TACZ,
Alex's Caves,
Ambient Sounds,
Another Furniture,
Apple Skin,
Artifacts,
Botany Pots,
Carry On,
Chipped,

Chunk Loaders,
Create and a lot of addons,
Dynamic Lights,
Easy Villagers,
Enchanted Golden Apple Addition,
Explorer's Compass,
Explosive Enhancement,
F-Tech core and equipement,
Farmer's Delight and a lot of addons,
Find Me,

Immersive Aircraft,

Supplementaries,
terralith,

All the Yung's Mods
